lines.japanese: 「空がまことに美しいねえー」
lines.english: “The sky is truly beautiful.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、今日はよく晴れてて温かいね」
lines.english: “Yes. It's clear and warm today.”

lines.japanese: 「ほんと、冬じゃないみたい」
lines.english: “It hardly feels like winter.”

lines.japanese: 三学期のある日。
lines.english: One day in the third term.

lines.japanese: 朝の通学路。僕と渡来さんは、空を見上げながら適当な会話で間を繋いでいた。
lines.english: On the road to school that morning, Watarai and I looked up at the sky, filling the time with idle conversation.

lines.japanese: あ、お疲れ様。ずっと見ててくれたんだよね。
lines.english: Oh. Thank you for staying with me all this way.

lines.japanese: いま君にも見えているだろうこの空は、いつもと変わらない色をしていた。
lines.english: The sky you can see now must be the same color as always.

lines.japanese: これがここ最近の僕の日常。はっきり言って、特別なことなんて何もない。
lines.english: This has been my everyday life lately. Frankly, nothing special happens at all.

lines.japanese: あ、いや、そんなこと言ったら渡来さんに失礼だってところから、君との話が始まったんだっけ。僕は彼女の言うとおり、鈍いのかもしれない。
lines.english: No, wait. Wasn’t that where our conversation began—with how saying that would be unfair to Watarai? Perhaps she is right about how dense I am.

lines.japanese: やっぱりこうして君に話すことができて良かった。
lines.english: I'm glad I had the chance to speak with you this way after all.

lines.japanese: 彼女がいる毎日は、とっておきで、とびっきりで、ひどく心地いい。
lines.english: Every day with her is precious, extraordinary, and deeply comfortable.

lines.japanese: そんな幸せがそばにあるってことを、ここ数日で伝えられたと思う。
lines.english: Over these past few days, I think I have shown you that happiness beside me.

lines.japanese: だから、うん、僕のこれからは何の心配もいらない。
lines.english: So yes, you have nothing to worry about in my future.

lines.japanese: きっとこれから先に語れることは、君にとって退屈な日常。僕と渡来さんにとってのみのロマンスだ。
lines.english: What I could tell you from here would surely be tedious everyday life to you. A romance belonging only to Watarai and me.

lines.japanese: だから今回はここまで。また小さな喧嘩でもしたら、ちょっと照れくさい僕たちのストーリーを君に聞いてもらおう。
lines.english: So this is where we stop for now. The next time we have some little quarrel, perhaps I'll let you hear another chapter of our somewhat embarrassing story.

lines.japanese: これは、そのあとの話だけど――
lines.english: Though this happened later—

lines.japanese: 「どした？　ぽかーんとしちゃって」
lines.english: “What's wrong? You're staring into space.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは退屈してたみたいだ。僕の顔を横から覗きこんできた。
lines.english: Watarai had apparently grown bored. She leaned in from the side to peer at my face.

lines.japanese: 「あ、えっと……空を飛べたら学校行くのも楽だろうな、なんて思って」
lines.english: “Oh, um... I was thinking how easy it would be to get to school if we could fly.”

lines.japanese: 「適当なこと言うなあ」
lines.english: “Now you're just saying whatever comes into your head.”

lines.japanese: バレていた。渡来さんに肘で突かれる。
lines.english: She had seen through me. Watarai nudged me with her elbow.

lines.japanese: 「でも便利そうじゃない？　空の上なら、誰にも邪魔されないでふたりっきりだし」
lines.english: “But wouldn't it be convenient? Up in the sky, no one could bother us, and we'd be alone together.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そういうことかあ。それなら賛成したくなるなあ」
lines.english: “Oh, so that's what you mean. In that case, I might be in favor.”

lines.japanese: 適当に続けた会話は、意外と好評な支持を受けつつ流れはじめた。
lines.english: The idle conversation I had improvised began to flow along with an unexpectedly favorable reception.

lines.japanese: 「あー、でも私スカートだ」
lines.english: “Oh, but I'm wearing a skirt.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな問題なんだ」
lines.english: “That's the problem you see?”

lines.japanese: それは確かに困るけれど。
lines.english: Though admittedly, it would be a problem.

lines.japanese: 「でも、これだけ科学が発達してるんだから、そろそろ人間が飛べる時代も来たって不思議じゃないよね」
lines.english: “But science has advanced so far. It wouldn't be strange if the age when people can fly arrived soon.”

lines.japanese: 「みんなが飛べちゃったら、二人きりではなくなるけどね」
lines.english: “If everyone can fly, we won't be alone anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、非現実的な話をしたいのに、どうしても現実的な問題と直面するなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm. I want to have an unrealistic conversation, but we keep running into practical problems.”

lines.japanese: そうは言いながらも、渡来さんの足取りは弾むように軽くなっている。どうやらちょっと楽しくなってきたらしい。
lines.english: Even as she said it, a bounce entered Watarai's steps. Apparently she was beginning to enjoy herself.

lines.japanese: 「あーあ、どっかふたりで遠くへいきたいなあ」
lines.english: “I wish we could go somewhere far away together.”

lines.japanese: 「冬休みずっと一緒だったじゃない」
lines.english: “We spent the entire winter break together.”

lines.japanese: 「これからもずっと一緒だけどね」
lines.english: “And we'll be together forever from now on.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、そういうの、僕が言うと恥ずかしいからやめろって怒るくせに」
lines.english: “Oh, you get angry and tell me to stop when I say something like that because it embarrasses you.”

lines.japanese: 「女の子はいいんだよ」
lines.english: “Girls are allowed.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんが笑う。僕も笑う。
lines.english: Watarai laughed. I laughed too.

lines.japanese: 世界はアップルソーダ越しに覗いたみたいに、今日も金色に輝いていた。
lines.english: The world shone gold today, as though I were seeing it through apple soda.

lines.japanese: 「なんだか恋人っぽい空気になってきたね」
lines.english: “This is starting to feel like a conversation between lovers.”

lines.japanese: 「まったくだよ。朝っぱらからこういうのやめようよ。ガッコー行くのがヤになる」
lines.english: “It really is. Let's not do this first thing in the morning. It'll make me hate going to school.”

lines.japanese: 「だったら、授業中も視線の交換とかしようよ」
lines.english: “Then let's exchange glances during class too.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあー、やめてって。ほんと。顔赤くなって、みんなと話せなくなる」
lines.english: “Oh, come on. Stop. Seriously. My face will turn red, and then I won't be able to talk to anyone.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 僕の渡来さんが照れている。そんな幸せが隣にある風景。
lines.english: My Watarai was embarrassed. There was my happiness, right beside me.

lines.japanese: 「ほーんと、どっか遠くへ行きたくなるよね」
lines.english: “It really does make you want to go somewhere far away.”

lines.japanese: 「なるなる」
lines.english: “It does, it does.”

lines.japanese: 「で、やっぱり翼でもあればなあ、って話に戻るんだね」
lines.english: “Which brings us back to wishing we had wings.”

lines.japanese: こうして僕らの会話はいつまでも繋がってゆく。
lines.english: And so our conversation would go on and on.

lines.japanese: 「翼？　あるよ。ほら、あるある」
lines.english: “Wings? We have them. See? Right here.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは胸の前で両手を組みあわせ、影絵の大鷲を作ってみせた。
lines.english: Watarai clasped her hands before her chest and made the shadow of a great eagle.

lines.japanese: 「ほうら、私たちにも翼くらいはあるんだぞう」
lines.english: “See? Even we have wings.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　なにその目。馬鹿にしてる？」
lines.english: “Hm? What's that look for? Are you making fun of me?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、そんなことないよ。やっぱり渡来さんだなあって感心しちゃった」
lines.english: “No, not at all. I was admiring how perfectly Watarai that was.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、やっぱり馬鹿にしてるよね」
lines.english: “Yes, you are making fun of me.”

lines.japanese: 彼女はちっぽけな翼を突きだして、僕にぶつける。
lines.english: She thrust her tiny wings at me and bumped them into my body.

lines.japanese: 空は飛べなくても、この素晴らしき日々を翔けていける幸せの翼。
lines.english: Wings of happiness that could not carry us through the sky, but could bear us soaring through these wonderful days.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん」
lines.english: “Watarai.”

lines.japanese: だから僕は、何度彼女に咎められても、つい口に出してしまう。
lines.english: And so, no matter how many times she complained, I couldn't help saying it aloud.

lines.japanese: 「この続きは帰ってから。二人っきりでいっぱい話そう」
lines.english: “We'll continue this when we get home. We'll talk all we want when we're alone.”

lines.japanese: 照れ屋な僕の恋人は、自前の翼で赤らんだ表情を隠す。
lines.english: My shy girlfriend hid her reddening face behind the wings she had made herself.

lines.japanese: 「大好きなひとと一緒なら、私どこまでも飛んでいきあすか」
lines.english: “With the person I love, I'll fly anywhere you Asuka me to.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱり馬鹿にしてる？」
lines.english: “You really are making fun of me.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “What did you say?”
